builds_on: LOCK 2 prayer, LOCK 3 Idris, LOCK 6 regulars, LOCK 34 runner. Private counters go to the Journal; worship never earns trust.

text: At the fountain in the masjid courtyard Idris rolls up his sleeves. “Intention first, in the heart. Then wash: hands, mouth, nose, face, arms to the elbows. Wipe your head and ears. Wash your feet to the ankles.”
“Allah wants to make you clean, not to make it hard for you.”
